124:t_012:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$n... was it...? I'll ask you just once.」

124:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Join $$サイデリアル$$. That $$スフィア$$ was never yours to begin with.」

124:t_012:6.en:
$n
「I... refuse... Who would... join a bunch of... invaders...?」

124:t_013:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That attack is coming again!」

124:t_013:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「All $$スフィア$$s will be gathered...」

124:t_014:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, concentrate your firepower on $$バルビエル$$!」

124:t_015:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You bastards should have died...!」

124:t_016:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Switch with me, $$刹那$$! I'll use my secret weapon!」

124:t_017:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If I close in on a high-firepower artillery machine...!」

124:t_019:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That man $$バルビエル$$'s machine scatters nanomachines that damage both machines and pilots!」

124:t_019:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Use highly concentrated $$ＧＮ粒子$$ to stop the nanomachines from functioning!」

124:t_019:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll use $$トランザムバースト$$!」

124:t_020:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That should keep things under control for now.」

124:t_021:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You did pretty well, $$ティエリア$$.」

124:t_021:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$流竜馬$$... Don't keep thinking I'm still the weakling who depended entirely on $$ヴェーダ$$.」

124:t_021:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n! You pull yourself together too!」

124:t_021:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If poison like that gets the better of you, you'll disgrace the $$陣代高校$$ $$ボランティア部$$!」

124:t_021:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thanks to $$刹那$$, $$ジェニオン$$ can still fight somehow...!」

124:t_021:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're all right too, Miss $$スズネ$$! I'll back you up, so give it all you've got!」

124:t_022:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Damn it...! Even those bastards who should have died in $$新日本$$ have joined them here...!」

124:t_023:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「All right, all right. Please withdraw, $$ギルター$$.」

124:t_023:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let's keep personal and professional matters separate. Call me what you like behind my back, but here, call me General $$サルディアス$$ properly.」

124:t_023:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I can still fight! To redeem myself, I'll take them...」

124:t_023:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... I admire your guts, but I wonder what our boss will say...」

124:t_023:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I think you'd best get your disgraceful self out of here before you upset him any further. For your own sake, yes.」

124:t_023:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「M-My apologies, Lord $$バルビエル$$...! I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, will withdraw!」

124:t_024:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I understand, Lord $$バルビエル$$. Please leave the rest to me, $$サルディアス$$.」

124:t_024:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I don't sense much fighting spirit from him...」

124:t_024:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Be careful, everyone. That man's behavior is a pose.」

124:t_024:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「Because of him and that $$バルビエル$$, $$新日本$$...」

124:t_024:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for that overly generous introduction. I am $$サルディアス・アクス$$... I'm forty-two years old this year.」

124:t_024:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I happen to serve as deputy commander of 《$$アンタレス$$》. We may only know each other for today, but I'm pleased to meet you.」

124:t_024:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「At last, we meet again...! I'll pay you back, $$バルビエル$$ and $$サルディアス$$!」

124:t_024:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You say that, but do you understand the situation you're in?」

124:t_024:12.en:
$$五飛$$
「Much as I hate to admit it, he's right.」

124:t_024:13.en:
$$カトル$$
「The battle is overwhelmingly against us.」

124:t_024:14.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$ロンド・ベル$$, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, and our own group are all worn out, and we're facing a huge enemy force...」

124:t_024:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「And that man is waiting in reserve.」

124:t_024:17.en:
$n
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

124:t_024:18.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, what's your assessment?」

124:t_025:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Given our current strength, six minutes is the limit for continuing this battle.」

124:t_025:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard him, everyone. We'll keep fighting for another six minutes.」

124:t_025:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Even if we can't take $$セントラル・ベース$$, this is a chance to wear down the Empire's forces.」

124:t_025:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「For the sake of our future battles, I propose we fight as long as we can.」

124:t_025:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「I understand. ...All units, you heard her!」

124:t_025:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You are admirable, truly admirable. That's just what I'd expect of $c, who fought through the $$時獄戦役$$.」

124:t_025:7.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Perhaps it's because so many men around me are quiet... Men who run their mouths get on my nerves.」

124:t_025:8.en:
$$スザク$$
「Let's do this with everything we've got, everyone...!」

124:t_025:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We have six more minutes... I'll wear down the enemy's forces as much as possible in that time...!」

124:t_025:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Be very wary of the enemy $$スフィア・リアクター$$! That machine seems to generate a special field around itself!」

124:t_025:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「Is that a $$スフィア・アクト$$...?!」

124:t_025:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It seems that power differs from one $$リアクター$$ to another.」

124:t_025:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「Let's do this! All units, begin the attack!」

124:t_025:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I understand. Let's show them six minutes of hell.」

124:t_026:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Given our current strength, five minutes is the limit for continuing this battle.」

124:t_026:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You heard him, everyone. We'll keep fighting for another five minutes.」
